title: AI Data Analysis: A New Approach - Multi-engine Joint State Data Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.00807v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI data analysis today is three fragmented worlds: LLMs understand semantics but cannot compute; BI aggregates precisely but is stateless; ML processes large-scale data on a stateful kernel but lacks semantics. This paper proposes a combination mechanism, named Multi-engine Joint State Data Analysis, that fills a still-open gap - the multi-engine joint context: the data context is embedded into LLM conversational analysis, where the LLM serves only as the semantic, reasoning, and orchestration layer (not computation) and connects four engines through the 1M context window - Python and R ML kernels, SQL over relational databases, Cypher over graph databases - yielding two multiplications, "semantics and precise computation" and "relational and graph", under enterprise-grade governance. The novelty is a four-dimensional coordinate system: horizontal (engine kinds), vertical (state flow - the watershed), spatial (business generalization

translated_title: AI数据分析：一种新方法——多引擎联合状态数据分析
translated_abstract: 如今的AI数据分析是三个割裂的世界：大语言模型（LLM）理解语义但无法进行计算；商业智能（BI）能精确聚合但无状态；机器学习（ML）能在有状态内核上处理大规模数据但缺乏语义。本文提出了一种组合机制，命名为多引擎联合状态数据分析，填补了一个至今悬而未决的空白——多引擎联合上下文：将数据上下文嵌入LLM对话式分析中，其中LLM仅充当语义、推理和编排层（不执行计算），并通过1M上下文窗口连接四个引擎——Python和R机器学习内核、关系数据库上的SQL、图数据库上的Cypher——从而在企业级治理下实现两个乘法效应：“语义与精确计算”以及“关系与图”。其创新之处在于一个四维坐标系：横向（引擎种类）、纵向（状态流动——分水岭）、空间（业务泛化……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“多引擎联合状态数据分析”机制，将数据上下文嵌入LLM对话式分析中，由LLM仅作为语义、推理与编排层，通过1M上下文窗口连接Python/R机器学习内核、SQL关系数据库和Cypher图数据库四大引擎，在企业级治理下实现“语义×精确计算”与“关系×图”两个乘法融合，填补了多引擎联合上下文这一空白。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Multi-engine Joint State Data Analysis, a combination mechanism that embeds data context into LLM conversational analysis, where the LLM serves solely as the semantic, reasoning, and orchestration layer and connects four engines—Python/R ML kernels, SQL over relational databases, and Cypher over graph databases—via a 1M context window, yielding the multiplications of "semantics × precise computation" and "relational × graph" under enterprise-grade governance to fill the still-open gap of multi-engine joint context.
